issues.evidence: Customer email (2026-10-27): 'A stone thrown up on the A6 motorway on 26 October 2026 cracked my windscreen' — windscreen damage with no collision with another vehicle. Veridia contract Article 2 coverage table (contract.pdf, page 1): C2 covers 'Damage to the insured vehicle after a collision' (€300 deductible) while C3 'Glass breakage' explicitly covers 'Windscreen, side windows' (€50 deductible). C3 is listed in the Policy Schedule for VER-1007, so Article 2 is satisfied. Because the recorded coverage is C2, the claims system applied the €300 C2 deductible and staged €880; under the correct C3 coverage the deductible is €50.

verdict.summary: All other facts check out (dates within the 5-day reporting deadline of Article 4.1, repair cost €1,180 matches the total incl. VAT on quote Q-2610-5246 per Article 1, both required C3 documents provided and belonging to Emma Rousseau / Tesla Model 3 / VER-1007, no exclusion, no third party so no playbook referral, and no assessor needed since €1,180 is not above €1,500 per Article 6.1), but the coverage was recorded as C2 instead of C3 glass breakage, which changes the deductible from €300 to €50 and the staged payout.
